title: docs(skills): teach the mappings group, action and hook texts, and drop the stale label-serving caveat
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg1XdbbGasMNVx41tq3hZKV4)_
Fixes #34962
Fixes #35097
Fixes #34053
Part of #34546 — this PR carries its i18n half only (where a hook's `texts` sit in a bundle, plus one i18n eval case). The declaration half (hook `texts` and `ctx.text` in `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`, plus one objectstack-data eval case) rides with the area's data-hooks group, per the PM's fence ruling in this dispatch: that file and the data eval set sit under open draft #34964 and the next data-hooks group.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:已发布技能 `objectstack-i18n` 的顶层分组列表加入 `mappings`(导入映射的 `label`,按映射 `name` 存放,附 showcase 的 zh-CN 实例);"按组织语言取句"一段扩到钩子与脚本动作在 `texts` 里声明、用 `ctx.text` 写入记录的句子(`hooks.HOOK.texts.KEY.message`、`_actions.ACT.texts.KEY.message`,无对象动作在 `globalActions` 下);删去已失效的"标签服务把内联文字当 `defaultLocale` 读"提醒,只保留仍然成立的一句:校验与拒绝消息仍经 `t()` 读标签,英文源、中文默认的应用仍需声明 `fallbackLocale: 'en'`。`objectstack-ui` 的 `rules/actions.md` 新增一小节,教脚本动作声明 `texts` 并用 `ctx.text` 取句。i18n 评测加 2 条、改 1 条,ui 评测加 1 条。
- 为什么改:`mappings` 分组、动作 `texts`、钩子 `texts` 都已在 main 上落地,但技能没教;照技能写包的 agent 会把映射名留成英文、把句子硬编码进动作体。旧提醒在 sourceLocale 服务落地后已经说错。
- 风险与回滚:只改发布技能文字、评测、一行 token 棘轮与 changeset;无运行时影响。`rules/actions.md` 的棘轮行 3180 → 3333(先删同文件两处复述示例的句子 53 字节,余额按实测);i18n SKILL.md 在原上限内付清(6327 → 6329,上限 6333 不动)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 第 50–53 行(新的 `t()` 提醒是否准确)与分组段(`mappings`、`texts` 键);② `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` 新增的 `texts` 小节;③ `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 中 actions.md 行的注释与 +153。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md is 3333 tokens (ceiling 3333; headroom 0)`、`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md is 6329 tokens (ceiling 6333; headroom 4)`,末行 ✓。
- 需要你做的:审阅并合并(`skills/**` 属 Tier H 受管面)。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`
  - The top-level group list names `mappings` (`mappings.{mapping}.label`, an import mapping's `label` by its `name`; a mapping declares no description). The zh-CN example block gains the showcase's `mappings: { showcase_inquiry_feed: { label: … } }`, the spelling `examples/app-showcase` ships. (#34962)
  - The paragraph on keys picked in the organization's language (it already carried the flow record-write key) now covers each sentence a hook or a `script` action declares in `texts` and writes through `ctx.text`: `hooks.{hook}.texts.{key}.message` and `_actions.{action_name}.texts.{key}.message`, also under `globalActions`. The skill states the bundle shape only. The declaration, the `ctx.text` lookup and the missing-key behaviour live in the ui actions rule (and, for hooks, the data-hooks group), so nothing is said a third time. (#35097, #34546 i18n half)
  - The caveat "Label serving still reads inline text as `defaultLocale` text …" is gone. The `sourceLocale` row now says a request in that locale is served the inline text. The remaining truth is kept, measured on `origin/main` `01889892` (see Acceptance notes): validation and refusal messages still read labels through `t()`, which falls back to `fallbackLocale`, else `defaultLocale`. Without `fallbackLocale: 'en'`, an `en` refusal names a field by its zh-CN row. (#34053)
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`: a new H3 "Writing in the organization's language (`texts`)" after the refusals paragraph. The same actions that may declare `refusals` (a `script` action with a `js` body) declare a sentence under `texts` and ask for it with `await ctx.text(key, params)`. It is answered in the organization's language, never the caller's. With no translation the declared sentence is written, filled. An unreadable Localization setting rejects. An undeclared key is refused at save when named literally, else at run. The H3 names the `texts.KEY.message` key beside the refusals key, which the refusals paragraph still spells in full. The wording comes from `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` as merged with the action-texts carrier. (#35097)
- Evals
  - `skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`: case 14 (`mappings.lead_csv.label`), case 15 (a hook's `texts` key and whose language picks it; it does not require the `{{ lead }}` hole), and case 11's `expected_output` now gives the `t()` reason for `fallbackLocale: 'en'`. Its `must_contain` keeps `fallbackLocale: 'en'`, decided below.
  - `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`: case 21 (the `send_email` action's subject via `texts` + `ctx.text`; it does not forbid the prompt's own `'Email: ' +`).
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the `rules/actions.md` row 3180 -> 3333 with its row note. The i18n row is untouched.
- `.changeset/34962-i18n-skill-texts.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch, carrying both declaration lines.

### Ratchet and size readings

Raise authority, quoted verbatim and untranslated: the standing ruling of 2026-10-27, 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」, made the gate-recognised path by ruling record 6513306068 (letter B). Restatement in the same file is cut first; the remainder moves by measurement.

- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`: paid in full in the same file, so the row does not move (open draft #34970 edits the same file). The restatement cut:
  - the renamed-target sentence, which restates the option paragraph's "parse, ship, and resolve to nothing" and the `translation-target-unknown` error stated just above it;
  - `--objects-only` and `--source-hashes` from the `extract --help` list, both taught in place (the paragraph right below and the Register code comment);
  - the group-name list in the `--objects-only` paragraph and the surface list in `os i18n check`'s paragraph, two partial copies of the group list (neither named `mappings`, `hooks` or `books`);
  - the empty step "### 2. Translate / Fill in the values manually.";
  - the flow-key language parenthetical, merged into the one sentence that now also covers `texts`.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`: paid down first by 53 bytes of restatement, each of the example right below its sentence: " as `${result.output.NAME}`" in the `onSuccess` sentence (27; the Convert Lead block spells `${result.output.opportunity_id}`) and "`{recordId}` placeholder; " in the `newTabUrl` sentence (26; the Open PDF block spells it). The refusals bundle key stays: the bundle's own evals grade `_actions`, and the with-skill arm reads this bundle only. Nothing else in the file restates another passage, so the rest moves by measurement: 12720 -> 13330 bytes, `ceil(13330 / 4) == 3333`, +153 tokens, pinned AT the measurement.

## Acceptance notes

- **A3 measured false.** The automation skill does not teach hooks. `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:9` sends object-layer lifecycle hooks to objectstack-data, and hooks, their `refusals` catalogue and its translation key are taught in `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` (§ Error Handling → Declared refusals). That file is outside this dispatch's fence, and per the PM it belongs to the data-hooks group. The automation skill is untouched.
- **The #34053 decision: case 11 keeps `fallbackLocale: 'en'` as a required string, with its reason rewritten.** Serving honours `sourceLocale` (the carrier merged as `2068e037`). But #34030 is still open: validation and refusal messages read labels through `t()`. Read on `origin/main` `01889892`: `resolveFieldLabel` (`packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts:463`) asks `ctx.translate` before the declared label, and `FileI18nAdapter.t()` (`packages/services/service-i18n/src/file-i18n-adapter.ts:176-181`) falls back to `fallbackLocale`, which the stack config fills as `fallbackLocale || defaultLocale || 'en'`. So in an English-source app with a zh-CN default, `fallbackLocale: 'en'` still keeps an `en` refusal off the zh-CN row. When #34030 lands, its own skills follow-up drops the sentence and the requirement. This is a reading of the tree; no request was run.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/README.md` lists each eval file's topics broadly. It is not extended for the new case.
